user.title: Connect a JURA machine
user.description:
Enter the IP address of the Wi-Fi Connect dongle.

Before you continue, on the machine:

1. Switch it on and **leave the settings menu**. The display has to show the start screen, otherwise the machine refuses the connection.
2. **Close the J.O.E. app**. The dongle serves only one connection at a time.

Home Assistant then pairs with the machine: confirm the request with **OK** on the machine.

data_description.host: Address of the Wi-Fi Connect dongle in your network.

pair_failed.title: Pairing failed
pair_failed.description:
Pairing with {host} did not work ({reason}).

Check on the machine:

- **Leave the settings menu.** The display has to show the start screen; while a menu is open the machine cannot ask for the confirmation.
- Close the J.O.E. app.
- Confirm the request with **OK** within 60 seconds.

Then try again.

data_description.pin: The setup PIN of the machine. Leave empty if none is set.

article.title: Which model is it?
article.description: The model could not be read from the machine, usually because Home Assistant is in a different network than the dongle. Enter the article number: it is shown in the J.O.E. app next to the machine name (for example 15833) and on the type plate on the underside of the machine. Leave it empty to pick the model from a list.

data_description.model: The model name including the regional variant, e.g. "E8 (SDS)". Type to search the list.

options.title: Area and options
options.description: Where is the machine, and what should Home Assistant offer? Everything except the area can be changed later under *Configure* on the integration.

data_description.area: Optional. The device of the machine is created in this area, so that all of its entities get the name of the area. This happens once; to move the machine later, change the area of the device.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two polls. The dongle accepts only one connection at a time, so do not go too low.
data_description.enable_brewing: Add a button per drink that brews it with the recipe stored on the machine, as selected at its display. Make sure a cup is in place before pressing. Also adds a cancel button and enables the action Brew with options.
data_description.enable_maintenance: Add buttons that start the maintenance programs of the machine (cleaning, descaling, milk system rinse, coffee system rinse, ...). The machine then asks for the confirmations on its display; the coffee system rinse runs right away, so put a cup under the spout. Also adds a cancel button.
data_description.enable_settings: Add entities for the settings of the machine (water hardness, switch-off time, language, ...) and a switch that locks its front panel. The values are read from the machine and written to it; a change needs the machine to be on and idle.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair again
reauth_confirm.description: The machine at {host} no longer accepts the stored credentials. Switch it on, **leave the settings menu** (the display has to show the start screen) and close the J.O.E. app. Confirm the connection request on the display after you submit.

reconfigure.title: Change the address
reconfigure.description:
Enter the new IP address of the Wi-Fi Connect dongle.

If Home Assistant cannot read the model from the machine because it is in another network than the dongle, add the article number: it is shown in the J.O.E. app next to the machine name and on the type plate. It has to belong to the model that is set up.

data_description.article_number: Optional, five digits. Leave empty to keep what is stored.

progress.pair:
Look at the display of the machine at {host} and confirm the connection request with **OK** within 60 seconds.

No request on the display? Leave the settings menu on the machine (back to the start screen) and try again.
progress.identify: Reading the model from the machine at {host}…

error.cannot_connect: The machine did not answer. Is it switched on and reachable from Home Assistant?
error.invalid_auth: The machine rejected the stored credentials.
error.pairing_timeout: The connection request was not confirmed on the machine in time. Leave the settings menu if one is open and try again.
error.pairing_rejected: The machine refused the connection request. This happens in the settings menu or when the machine is busy: go back to the start screen and try again.
error.machine_in_menu: The machine is in its settings menu and cannot ask for the confirmation. Leave the menu (back to the start screen) and try again.
error.machine_busy: The machine is busy (brewing or running a maintenance program). Wait until it is finished and try again.
error.unknown_article: This article number is not in the list of known JURA machines.
error.article_other_model: This article number belongs to a different machine type than the one that is set up. To change the model, remove the integration and set it up again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.reauth_successful: Pairing succeeded, the machine is connected again.

brew.name: Brew with options
brew.description: Brews the drink of a brew button and changes single parameters of its recipe for this drink only. Everything that is not given stays as stored on the machine. Make sure a cup is in place.

strength.name: Strength
strength.description: Coffee strength, as a level the machine offers for the drink.

water_amount.name: Water amount
water_amount.description: Amount of water in millilitres, within the range the drink allows.

milk_foam_time.name: Milk foam time
milk_foam_time.description: Seconds that milk foam is dispensed.

milk_break.name: Milk break
milk_break.description: Seconds of pause between the milk and the coffee.

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.description: Millilitres of water that bypass the coffee, as for an Americano.

auth_failed.message: The machine rejected the stored credentials. Pair it again.

machine_busy.message: The machine is busy right now (brewing, in its menu or running a maintenance program).

product_blocked.message: {product} cannot be brewed right now. Check the machine for active alerts.

cancel_failed.message: Could not cancel the current action: {error}

lock_failed.message: Could not lock or release the front panel: {error}

not_a_brew_button.message: This action works on the brew buttons only.

brew_option_range.message: {option} for {product} has to be between {minimum} and {maximum}.

brew_option_step.message: {option} for {product} has to be {minimum} plus a multiple of {step}.

brew_option_choice.message: {option} for {product} has to be one of: {allowed}.
